gloss: trump card; ace up one's sleeve

definitions.explanation: A special move or technique kept hidden and used only when ordinary means fail.

examples.japanese: ついに{奥|おく}の{手|て}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: At last I used my trump card.
He seems to have something up his sleeve still.

examples.japanese: ⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|い}き{詰|づ}まった→行き詰まる：09346_ikizumaru⟧とき、⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{奥|おく}の{手|て}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{値下|ねさ}げ→値下げ：07583_nesage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提案|ていあん}した→提案する：06057_teiansuru⟧。
examples.english: When the negotiations stalled, the president proposed a price cut as his last resort.

- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{奥|おく}の{手|て}: one's very last resort
